---
title: "Features"
description: "Implemented capabilities of GRETL Runtime."
---

GRETL Runtime executes Groovy jobs on Java 25. Tasks form a directed graph and
run sequentially; explicit data dependencies determine which predecessors run.

## Data processing

The distribution provides 44 operations for HTTP, FTP, S3, ZIP/GZIP, SQL,
DuckDB, INTERLIS validation and import/export, CSV, JSON, Excel, GeoPackage,
Shapefile, AV transformations and DXF. Inspect fields with `gretl operations`.
DuckDB supports configured file and PostgreSQL sources and export targets.

## Script and packaged jobs

Run a single script or a project with declarative `settings.gretl` includes.
The optional packager compiles a job into an executable JAR with explicitly
selected task modules and resources. The JAR runs with Java 25.

## Diagnostics and extensions

Jobs share parameter resolution, cancellation, time budgets, managed resources,
structured diagnostics and a JSON run report. Custom Java operations and Groovy
actions use the same runner. GeoTools remains an isolated optional compatibility
test profile.

Scheduling belongs to the process launcher or external orchestration. Publisher,
XtfToGpkg and Native Image are future work. See the [documentation](docs.qmd).
